content: CitraNatal DHA is a prescription multi-vitamin and mineral supplement designed to improve the nutritional status of women before conception, during pregnancy, and in the postnatal period, whether they are breastfeeding or not. It is taken as one tablet and one soft gel daily or as directed by a healthcare provider. This product is contraindicated in individuals with known hypersensitivity to any of its ingredients. It is important to note that consuming more than 3 grams of omega-3 fatty acids per day may have antithrombotic effects, such as increased bleeding time and INR. Therefore, omega-3 fatty acids should be avoided in patients taking anticoagulants or those with inherited or acquired bleeding disorders. Additionally, folic acid alone is not an appropriate treatment for pernicious anemia or other megaloblastic anemias caused by vitamin B12 deficiency. High doses of folic acid (above 0.1 mg daily) may mask pernicious anemia by allowing hematologic remission while neurological symptoms continue to progress. Adverse reactions reported include allergic sensitization, which has been observed with both oral and parenteral administration of folic acid. There is limited information available regarding postmarketing experience, drug interactions, and specific population use, including pediatric, geriatric, and immunocompromised patients. CitraNatal DHA is classified as a Pregnancy Category supplement by the FDA, but there is no specific guidance from the Australian Drug Evaluation Committee (ADEC) regarding its use during pregnancy. Similarly, there is no FDA guidance on its use during labor and delivery, in nursing mothers, or in patients with renal or hepatic impairment. The product is administered orally and is available in six child-resistant blister packs, each containing five tablets and five soft gels. Contact with moisture should be avoided to prevent discoloration or erosion of the tablets. CitraNatal DHA includes Ferr-Ease®, a patented dual-iron delivery system with both quick-release and slow-release iron. The multi-vitamin/mineral tablet is white, oval, and scored, with CN 1 debossed on one side. The DHA soft gel is caramel-colored and contains a light yellow to orange semi-solid mixture of essential fatty acids. Patients should consult their healthcare provider for any dietary concerns or questions about alcohol interactions with this medication. For serious adverse events or product information, patients can call (210) 696-8400.
